messages.subject: ACF plots in knitr
parts:
Hi all,

I'm creating a .html file with knitr and markdown.  The ACF plots are not really showing up well.

The code is 

par(mfrow=c(3,4))
MIacf <- plot(fitm1, plot.type="acf")

and the plot looks like what is shown in the attachment.  However, when I run the specific knitr chunk it in Rstudio, it comes looks fine.  Any thoughts?

Thanks.

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: ACF plots in knitr
parts:
Hi David,

Resizing multi-panel figures to look good in pdf/html/etc can be tedious. You typically need to set extra options for your code chunk, like fig.height and out.height. And the best settings vary depending on the plot. See here:

https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/figure-size.html

Ed
